title: c-PCR-036 Plastic piping systems inside the building structure (EN 16904:2025)
program_operator: EPD International AB (The International EPD System)

document.status_note: PDF p5 confirms version 1.0.0, published 2026-02-04 (original version), valid until 2030-04-07; update initiated if a new EN 16904 is released.

depends_on_unavailable: EN 16904:2025 (entire normative content: declared/functional unit, modules, technical data, scenarios, RSL, cut-off/allocation specifics)
EN 806, EN 1264, EN 12056, EN 12828 (listed under standards conformance, undated)

rules.title: Piping system installed inside the building structure
rules.requirement: The c-PCR covers plastics piping systems inside the building structure and their main structural components; systems outside the building structure are out of scope.

rules.title: Pressure or non-pressure application stated
rules.requirement: EN 16904:2025 addresses both pressure and non-pressure applications; the application type should be recorded.

rules.title: Application system standard identified
rules.requirement: The c-PCR lists EN 806, EN 1264, EN 12056 and EN 12828 under standards conformance; the system standard applicable to the piping system should be identified.

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-036 by registration number
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include its registration number (c-PCR-036).

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-036 by name
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include the c-PCR name.

any_of: Plastic piping systems inside the building structure
Plastics piping systems inside the building structure

rules.title: EPD cites c-PCR-036 version
rules.requirement: Any reference to this c-PCR shall include its version number (1.0.0 for this ruleset).

rules.title: Used together with PCR 2019:14
rules.requirement: The c-PCR cannot be used on its own; it shall be applied together with PCR 2019:14 Construction products, so the EPD must also reference PCR 2019:14 (any valid version).

rules.title: Used together with EN 15804
rules.requirement: The c-PCR shall be applied together with EN 15804; the EPD must state conformance with EN 15804.

rules.title: EPD states conformance with EN 16904:2025
rules.requirement: Standards conformance for this c-PCR is EN 16904:2025; modules, LCA rules and EPD content follow PCR 2019:14 and EN 16904:2025, so the EPD should name EN 16904 as applied.

rules.title: c-PCR-036 v1.0.0 is valid at date of issue
rules.requirement: Version 1.0.0 was published 2026-02-04 and is valid until 2030-04-07; an EPD citing it should be issued within that window.

manual_checks.title: Product is within EN 16904:2025 scope
manual_checks.reason: Scope covers plastics piping systems inside buildings and their main structural components, including metal fittings and manifolds used in a plastic piping system. Which components form the declared 'system' is defined in the unavailable standard.

manual_checks.title: Type of EPD and information modules per EN 16904:2025
manual_checks.reason: The c-PCR only says 'as in PCR 2019:14 and EN 16904:2025'. Any module restrictions, mandatory modules or allowed EPD types beyond the parent PCR are defined in EN 16904:2025, which is not available; a reviewer must check them.

manual_checks.title: LCA methodology per EN 16904:2025
manual_checks.reason: Declared/functional unit, system boundary, cut-off, allocation, default scenarios, RSL and any product-specific calculation rules are delegated to EN 16904:2025, including how the declared unit relates to pipe length, nominal diameter and fittings. Not encoded because the standard is not available.

manual_checks.title: EPD content and format per EN 16904:2025
manual_checks.reason: Technical data to declare, additional information and any extra reporting/statements are delegated to EN 16904:2025; verify manually against the standard.

manual_checks.title: Deviations from 'should' recommendations justified
manual_checks.reason: Any deviation from a recommendation shall be justified in the EPD development process; whether a justification is adequate needs human judgement.

notes: Apart from scope and administrative data, every substantive section of this c-PCR (2.2.2 type of EPD/modules, 2.2.3 geography, 2.2.4 EPD validity, 4 LCA rules, 5 EPD content, 6 glossary) only says 'as in PCR 2019:14' and/or the EN standard. Rules from PCR 2019:14 are covered by parent ruleset epd-intl-pcr-2019-14-v2.0.1 and are not repeated here.
No defaults are given in the c-PCR itself; all default scenarios/values live in the unavailable EN standard or in the parent PCR, hence 'defaults' is empty.

Section 1.2 allows use with any valid version of PCR 2019:14 regardless of the version cited in the c-PCR, so pairing with parent ruleset epd-intl-pcr-2019-14-v2.0.1 is acceptable. No override of parent PCR rules is stated in this c-PCR.
The PCR was developed within CEN and adopted without extra open consultation or review (section 3); PCR moderator and committee are 'not applicable'.
REF.01-REF.04 and STD.01 search the full rendered EPD text (document.text); no doc_section is set to avoid depending on section naming.

VAL.01 compares ISO-8601 date strings lexicographically (expression string literals are an extension of the README syntax); it is derived from the c-PCR publication/validity dates and the GPI principle that a valid PCR must be used.
Obligation semantics (section 1.1): 'shall' = requirement, 'should' = recommendation whose deviation must be justified, 'may'/'can' = permitted option.
Publication date 2026-02-04 is from the PDF (p1 header, p5, p12); the requester did not state it.
No UN CPC code is identified for this product category (p6), so no classification rule is encoded.

Declared/functional unit (e.g. 1 m of pipe system of stated nominal diameter) is not given in the c-PCR; it is defined in EN 16904:2025 - not available. No unit or mass-per-metre formula check is encoded.

Source errors in section 7 (p11): EN 16904:2025 is titled 'Curtain walling - Plastics piping systems ...' and EN 13830 (curtain walling product standard) is listed - apparent copy-paste from the curtain-walling c-PCR. References also cite PCR 2019:14 v1.1 and GPI v4.0, which are outdated; section 1.2 allows any valid PCR 2019:14 version.

Naming inconsistency: cover/header use 'Plastics piping systems', administrative name (p5) uses 'Plastic piping systems'; REF.02 accepts both. Copyright footer says 2025 although the document is dated 2026-02-04.
Scope note: metal fittings (including manifolds) used in a plastic piping system are within the guidance of EN 16904:2025.
